easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional green creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another green creature.
When the creature dies, Savra's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
